payload.claim: The docstring's one-line summary ('Clone the mirror into the volume at `base_sha` on `branch`, cell running.') is no longer accurate for the function as it stands after this diff: when `stacked_on` is set the checkout ref is the parent's head, not `base_sha`. The discrepancy is resolved by a paragraph further down (lines 70-74), so nothing is actually hidden, but a reader skimming only the summary line gets the old contract.
